paragraphs: Per the file, ltHash instantiated with BLAKE3 (per the file) and a 2048-byte output (per the file) uses 1024 16-bit elements with (per the file) arithmetic modulo 2^16. Per the file, the reported query complexity (per the file) is below 2^128, but (per the file) the evaluated attack remains impractical. Per the file, there is also an acct-state constraint. Per the file, with the evaluated attack (per the file) parameters, the two colliding (per the file) sets contain at least (per the file) 550^8 (approximately 2^72.83) items (per the file) in total.
